title: WOTW First Look
author: sethekow5
selftext:
After six months of intense hard work, I’ve finally created the game I’ve dreamed of for years. After countless failed attempts to learn Unreal and Unity, and facing rejection while job hunting in information security, I found my purpose. At my lowest point, I started building this in 3js with the help of AI fixing bugs and codes, and now I’m 20 levels into my 100-level goal. The journey has been rough, but this project is exactly what keeps me going. 🎮🚀✨

I hope in the future I would get the necessary assistance to create this story rich in an engine. I am looking for partnership and some friends who would play test and give me some suggestions.

comments.author: sethekow5
comments.body:
1. I used GPT to generate characters, environments, props, and sheets, then built them all in Blender.
2. I built my own rigging platform with Claude that analyzes the character and rig.
3. I used ElevenLabs for the dialogue, music, and narration.
4. Claude helps me fix any glitches or bugs whenever I get stuck.
5. I usually make my characters in a T-pose to make rigging easier with my software, KRIG.
Each level took a week of planning and work. I think I need a break to get outside.

comments.author: NoBackupDev
comments.body: Keep it up man. It looks good. Its difficult to identify what the gameplay is though. Is it a platformer? Souls like?

replies.author: sethekow5
replies.body: Thanks man, Fair question. It is a 3D action game, closest to a Souls-like but each level is a road you fight and explore through mobs, secrets, lore pages according my designed world, and it ends in an intense keeper boss fight. The bosses are the heart of the game, they read their tells, parry, break their guard, survive their forms. The whole game twist is you never kill them,it is forbidden, you seal them, and they kneel in chains for their last words. There are some jumping and light platforming on the roads, but it is not a platformer. Currently it runs on PC and Android. I will do a follow up by posting a gameplay clip of a full boss fight next so it's clearer.
